name: Refrigerator
blurb: Not cooling, leaking, noisy, or an ice maker that quit — refrigerators are the highest-urgency repair in a Phoenix summer.

name: Washer
blurb: Won't drain, spin, or fill, or water on the floor — a washer that stops can pile up laundry in a day.

name: Dryer
blurb: No heat, long dry times, or a drum that will not turn. Leave gas and electrical dryer repairs to a trained technician.

name: Dishwasher
blurb: Not cleaning, not draining, or leaking at the door.

name: Oven & Range
blurb: Won't heat, a burner that will not light, or a cooktop fault on a gas or electric range.

name: Microwave
blurb: No heat, a turntable that will not spin, or a built-in unit that has shut down.

name: Ice Maker
blurb: No ice, slow production, or a standalone or built-in ice machine that needs service.

name: Freezer
blurb: Frost buildup, temperature swings, or a freezer that has stopped getting cold.
